title: Fix dimensions not populated by "Get Order Lines" on Purchase Invoices
summary: The 'Get Order Lines' function on purchase invoices now copies dimension sets from order lines, fixing a bug where dimensions were reset to defaults during line validation.
key_points: Dimensions from purchase order lines are now preserved when creating invoice lines via 'Get Order Lines'
The fix validates the Dimension Set ID from the order line to the invoice line
Added test case GetOrderLinesCopiesDimensionsToInvoiceLine to verify the behavior
Resolves issue where dimension validation would reset to item or account defaults
quote: Get Order Lines created invoice lines without the order line's dimensions
